pages.heading: Wood fences built for North Louisiana.
pages.intro: Pine and cedar fencing built to the height and layout your property needs, for privacy, security and shade.
pages.seoTitle: Wood Fences Monroe & West Monroe LA | Twin City Fence
pages.seoDescription: Custom pine and cedar wood fencing installed across Monroe, West Monroe and Ouachita Parish. Built in varying heights for privacy, security and shade.

sections.heading: Two woods, built to the same standard.
sections.body: We can build a fence for your location from either pine or cedar, and in varying heights. Pine is the budget-conscious choice for a long run of privacy fencing; cedar costs more and holds up better to weather and insects over time. Which one makes sense usually comes down to the length of the run and how long you want to leave it alone.

sections.heading: Privacy, security and shade.
sections.body: Custom pine and cedar privacy fencing built for security, shade, and a clean finished look. Height and picket spacing change what the fence actually does — a full-privacy panel and a spaced picket run are different fences for different problems, and it is worth deciding which one you are buying before the posts go in.

pages.heading: Chain-link fencing for homes, pets and property lines.
pages.intro: Durable, budget-conscious fencing for homes, pets, businesses, and larger properties across Monroe and West Monroe.
pages.seoTitle: Chain Link Fence Monroe LA | Twin City Fence
pages.seoDescription: Chain-link fencing installed in Monroe, West Monroe and Ouachita Parish for homes, pets, businesses, larger properties and sports enclosures.

sections.heading: The practical choice for a long run.
sections.body: Durable, budget-conscious fencing for homes, pets, businesses, and larger properties. Chain-link covers more ground per dollar than any other fence we build, which is why it tends to win on acreage, on commercial yards, and anywhere the job is containment rather than privacy.

sections.heading: Sports and court enclosures.
sections.body: The same system goes up tall — we have built chain-link at tennis courts, where the fence is doing a different job again: keeping a ball in rather than keeping anything out. Taller runs need heavier posts and closer spacing, so it is worth saying up front what the enclosure is for.

sections.heading: What to have ready.
sections.body: The three things that decide a price are the type of fence, the length of the run, and what the ground is doing — slope, trees and existing posts all change the job. Rough numbers are fine on a first call; we work the rest out on site.

sections.heading: Monroe, West Monroe and Ouachita Parish.
sections.body: We install across Monroe, West Monroe and the surrounding Ouachita Parish area, and travel further into North Louisiana for larger jobs. If you are not sure whether you are in range, call and ask.

sections.heading: The look, or the livestock.
sections.body: Whether you want it for the classic look, or need it to manage livestock, we can build any length split rail fence for you. Those two jobs pull in different directions on rail count and spacing, so it is worth saying which one you are after.

sections.heading: Monroe and West Monroe are one market.
sections.body: We are based in West Monroe and install on both sides of the Ouachita. Monroe is the larger half of the market and most of what we build there is residential privacy fencing and chain-link.

sections.heading: Five kinds of fence.
